notes: CPU-only on purpose (enable_gpu=false): downloading data must not burn GPU quota.

slug=null -> the kaggle service runner derives the kernel name from the <type>-<name> convention. Kernels live in a Kaggle collection named after the model (maintained in the UI — the API has no collections endpoint).
To resume a PARTIAL run, add this same slug to kernel_sources so the previous version's tar is mounted; the notebook auto-detects it and downloads only the remainder.
external-secrets provides HF_TOKEN for higher Hub rate limits (works without it too).
